name: Mikawa Wan Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of Mikawa Bay with its island-dotted waters, the Takeshima causeway, the Chita and Atsumi peninsulas and the Gamagori coast.
notes: Managed by Aichi. Takeshima's shrine causeway and the bay cruises are highlights.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
